property_summary: After a successful fallback call when block.number is NOT a multiple of 15, the contract's balance must be non-zero in the reference (since no transfer occurs); the mutant incorrectly transfers on non-multiples, so it will have a zero balance after such a call, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the payment condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0 so ether is transferred on most blocks instead of only multiples of 15.
